title: Ahimsa
one_line: Not causing injury to anyone, in any form, at any time, for any reason.
points: Ahimsa means not causing injury to anyone, including animals, in any form, at any time, or for any reason, in word, thought, or deed.
Guruji writes that if an injury has Vedic sanction, it does not constitute ahimsa.
Two animals hostile to each other will forget their hostility in the vicinity of those who practice absolute ahimsa.

sutra.translation: Upon being established in non-hurtfulness, there is a relinquishing of hostility in the presence of that (ahimsa).
